description: Source code for device utility functions, including command handling, interactive CLI, and category management in a device SDK.

methods.name: buildCategories
methods.description: Initializes the categories linked list with core and zigbee categories.

methods.name: destroyCategories
methods.description: Destroys the categories linked list and frees resources.

methods.name: showInteractiveHelp
methods.description: Displays help information for all categories.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Executes a command based on input arguments.

methods.name: findCommand
methods.description: Finds a command by name across categories.

methods.name: handleInteractiveCommand
methods.description: Handles user input commands in interactive mode, including 'quit', 'help', and other commands.

methods.name: completionCallback
methods.description: Provides command and category completions for CLI auto-completion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the device utility CLI application, handling command-line args and interactive session.
